title: Suncor Energy (SU) Up 8.9% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Suncor Energy reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, beating estimates with adjusted operating earnings of $2.33 per share (vs. $2.14 consensus) and revenues of $12.7 billion (vs. $10.3 billion consensus). The outperformance was driven by stronger downstream margins, higher upstream price realizations, and increased refined product sales. The stock has gained 8.9% since the earnings report, outperforming the S&P 500. However, Zacks assigns it a Hold rating, expecting in-line returns in the coming months.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company significantly beat earnings and revenue estimates, demonstrated strong operational performance with record refining throughput and refined product sales, generated substantial free cash flow ($4 billion), and returned nearly $1.8 billion to shareholders. However, the Hold rating suggests limited upside potential despite strong fundamentals.

Peer company in the same industry showed strong performance with 18.3% gain over the past month, reported 41.4% year-over-year revenue growth, and EPS improvement from $0.33 to $1.11. Also assigned a Hold rating with VGM Score of A, indicating solid fundamentals.

title: National Champions are Honoured at the Closing Ceremony of the Skills Canada National Competition 2026, in Toronto
author: Skills/Compétences Canada
description: Skills Canada National Competition 2026 concluded in Toronto with over 500 students and apprentices competing for national champion titles across 40+ skill areas. The event promoted skilled trades and technology careers to thousands of student visitors, with support from government partners and corporate sponsors including Home Hardware, UA Canada, Cenovus Energy, and Air Canada.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Identified as Presenting Sponsor, indicating corporate support for skilled trades education and youth career development.
RBC Future Launch awarded $1,500 Best of Region Awards to top competitors, showing active investment in youth skills training and career advancement.

title: Les champions nationaux sont à l'honneur à la cérémonie de clôture des Olympiades canadiennes des métiers et des technologies 2026, à Toronto
author: Skills/Compétences Canada
description: Skills/Compétences Canada held the closing ceremony of the 2026 Canadian Olympiads for Skilled Trades and Technologies in Toronto, where over 500 students and apprentices competed for national titles across 40+ disciplines. The event featured thousands of student visitors, industry leaders, and celebrity participants, with the next competition scheduled for Calgary in 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Presented the RBC Regional Excellence Award worth $1,500 to top competitors in each province/territory, demonstrating commitment to supporting skilled trades education and youth development.
Listed as a presenting sponsor, showing corporate investment in promoting skilled trades careers and workforce development initiatives.

title: Skills/Compétences Canada Officially Launches the Skills Canada National Competition 2026, in Toronto
author: Skills/Compétences Canada
description: Skills Canada launched its National Competition 2026 in Toronto on May 27, featuring over 500 competitors across 40+ skilled trade and technology categories. The two-day event at Enercare Centre aims to inspire youth to pursue careers in skilled trades, addressing a projected shortage of 700,000 tradespeople by decade's end as current workers retire.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Named as a presenting sponsor of SCNC 2026, demonstrating commitment to supporting skilled trades workforce development.
